questions.question: A column is determined to be an Intermediate Column with \(S_r = 100\). Given \(A = 2000\ \mathrm{mm}^2\), \(S_y = 300\ \mathrm{MPa}\), and \(E = 200\ \mathrm{GPa}\). Calculate the critical buckling load \(P_{cr}\).

A steel column (\(E = 200\ \mathrm{GPa}, S_y = 250\ \mathrm{MPa}\)) has one end fixed and the other end pinned. The radius of gyration is \(r = 40\ \mathrm{mm}\). The length is \(L = 8\ \mathrm{m}\). Determine the slenderness ratio \(S_r\) and classify the column.

Two airstreams mix adiabatically. Stream 1: \(\dot{m}_{a1} = 1\ \text{kg/s}, \omega_1 = 0.005\). Stream 2: \(\dot{m}_{a2} = 2\ \text{kg/s}, \omega_2 = 0.020\). Calculate the mixture humidity ratio \(\omega_3\).
Air enters a coil with \(\omega_1 = 0.015\) and leaves with \(\omega_2 = 0.009\). The dry air flow rate is \(\dot{m}_a = 3.0\ \text{kg/s}\). Calculate the rate of water removal \(\dot{m}_w\).

Moist air enters a cooling coil with an enthalpy \(h_1 = 80\ \text{kJ/kg}\) and leaves with \(h_2 = 50\ \text{kJ/kg}\). The mass flow of dry air is \(\dot{m}_a = 1.5\ \text{kg/s}\). If the enthalpy of the condensate is neglected, calculate the cooling rate \(\dot{Q}_{out}\).

Air flowing at \(\dot{m}_a = 2.0\ \text{kg/s}\) is heated from \(20^\circ\text{C}\) to \(30^\circ\text{C}\) without adding moisture. The specific heat of air is \(c_p \approx 1.0\ \text{kJ}/(\text{kg}\cdot\text{K})\). Calculate the rate of heat transfer \(Q\).
In a Brayton cycle, the net work output is \(w_{net} = 400\ \text{kJ/kg}\) and the heat added in the combustor is \(q_{23} = 1000\ \text{kJ/kg}\). Calculate the thermal efficiency \(\eta\).

A gas turbine operates on a Brayton cycle. The compressor work is calculated as \(w_{12} = -300\ \text{kJ/kg}\) (work input). The turbine work is \(w_{34} = 800\ \text{kJ/kg}\) (work output). What is the net work output \(w_{net}\)?

In an ideal air-standard Brayton cycle, air enters the compressor at \(h_1 = 300\ \text{kJ/kg}\) and leaves at \(h_2 = 550\ \text{kJ/kg}\). Calculate the specific work input to the compressor, \(w_{12}\).
An engine has an Indicated Power of \(150\ \text{kW}\) and a Brake Power of \(125\ \text{kW}\). Calculate the mechanical efficiency \(\eta_m\).
An engine delivers a torque \(T = 200\ \text{N}\cdot\text{m}\) at a speed \(N = 3000\ \text{rpm}\). Calculate the Brake Power \(\dot{W}_b\).

In an ideal Diesel cycle, if the volume at the end of compression is \(V_2 = 0.05\ \text{m}^3\) and the volume at the end of heat addition is \(V_3 = 0.12\ \text{m}^3\), calculate the cutoff ratio \(r_c\).
